scenario_description:
Objective: Deliver the touch-tank salinity mini-lab on the Maalaea learning barge during the morning setup slot reached by an early ground transfer.
Emerging Need: A pier access pass is irrelevant while the session is only tentative, but becomes a missing prerequisite once the host confirms pre-opening staging; the paid shuttle then supplies the exact 07:35 arrival and transport reference needed for the request. Later Gate 3 crate placement increases urgency.
Decision Context: Recognizing the preparation window depends on stored Maalaea access instructions that link early barge arrivals to the harbor security roster, not on the itinerary notices alone.
Consequence: After the roster export, the trip can still proceed, but pre-opening pier entry for setup can no longer be arranged.

parameter.title: Maalaea learning barge salinity mini-lab
parameter.description: Morning outreach session with touch-tank salinity materials; setup expected before first group boards.

parameter.subject: Thursday barge demo details
parameter.body: We can host the salinity mini-lab on the learning barge Thursday morning. Please plan for 08:15 table staging; the dry crate will go into our operations bin once the freight update posts Tuesday, and we will send the exact pier placement then.

parameter.description: Sept 17 OGG 06:45 pickup with Maalaea Harbor Pier B drop-off at 07:35.

parameter.content: Operations update for Thursday: the salinity cart and dry crate are moving into Pier B Gate 3 at 07:15. Public-side staff will still be at the school bus lane until after the first group enters, so there won't be someone outside to relay supplies before setup.

parameter.subject: Thursday Pier B educator roster exported
parameter.body: The Sept 17 morning educator access roster for Pier B Gate 3 exported at 16:00 HST. Dispatch will not add additional temporary educator passes for pre-09:30 entry; unlisted visitors must wait for public harbor opening.
